text.jp:
あらゆる症状に効くといわれる野菜
かなりの高額
text.official_en: A type of vegetable said to allay all manner of adverse symptoms. Known to be quite expensive.
text.real_en: A vegetable said to help with all kinds of symptoms. Very expensive.

text.jp:
すべてを超えた者に贈られる、
コロシアム超上級をクリアした証
text.official_en: Bestowed upon one who has overcome all trials. Proof of conquering the Champion League.
text.real_en: Bestowed upon one who has overcome all trials. Proof of conquering the Super Advanced tier.

text.jp: オルデリオンでも特に清らかな水
text.official_en: Water of the highest purity, even for Olderion.

text.jp:
コロシアム上級をクリアした証
アイテム交換所にアイテムが増える
text.official_en:
Proof of conquering the Gladiator League in the Colosseum.
Unlocks additional items at the exchange shop.
text.real_en:
Proof of conquering the Advanced tier in the Colosseum.
Unlocks additional items at the exchange shop.

text.jp:
コロシアム中級をクリアした証
アイテム交換所にアイテムが増える
text.official_en:
Proof of conquering the Brawler League in the Colosseum.
Unlocks additional items at the exchange shop.
text.real_en:
Proof of conquering the Intermediate tier in the Colosseum.
Unlocks additional items at the exchange shop.

text.jp:
コロシアム初級をクリアした証
アイテム交換所にアイテムが増える
text.official_en:
Proof of conquering the Fledgling League in the Colosseum.
Unlocks additional items at the exchange shop.
text.real_en:
Proof of conquering the Beginner tier in the Colosseum.
Unlocks additional items at the exchange shop.

text.jp: セキュリティレベル1のエリアに入れるようになるカードキー
text.official_en: A keycard that grants access to the level 1 security area.

text.jp: セキュリティレベル2のエリアに入れるようになるカードキー
text.official_en: A keycard that grants access to the level 2 security area.

text.jp: セキュリティレベル3のエリアに入れるようになるカードキー
text.official_en: A keycard that grants access to the level 3 security area.

text.jp:
ゾルダード城と地下牢をへだてる鉄格子を開けるための鍵
失くした看守はタダでは済まないだろう
text.official_en: A key that opens the way out from the Zoldaad castle dungeons. A jailer somewhere must be beside themselves right now...
text.real_en: A key to the iron gate separating Zoldaad Castle from its dungeon. The guard who lost it probably won’t get off lightly.

text.jp:
ゾルダード城地下にある牢屋を開けることができる鍵
囚人たちが喉から手が出るほど欲している
text.official_en: The key to the cells in the Zoldaad castle dungeons. Every prisoner would rather get their hands on this than food.
text.real_en: A key to the cells beneath Zoldaad Castle. The prisoners are desperate to get their hands on it.

text.jp: ゾルダード城玉座の扉をあけることができる鍵
text.official_en: A key that opens the door to the throne room in Zoldaad Castle.

text.jp: チョコボ入手後、チョコボの見た目を魔導アーマーに変えることができる
text.official_en: After acquiring a chocobo, grants the ability to change its appearance into that of magitek armor.

text.jp: ファルム大陸北部にある空き小屋を開ける鍵
text.official_en: A key to an abandoned cabin located in the north of the continent of Pharm.

text.jp:
レーダーの出力をアップする装置
ミシディアレーダーの改造素材になる
text.official_en:
A device that increases radar output.
Can be used to upgrade the Mysidia Radar.

text.jp:
ローブの男から受け取った手紙
ダリオからシモンに宛てたもの
text.official_en:
A letter handed to you by a robed man.
It is addressed from Dario to Simon.
text.real_en:
A letter received from a robed man.
Written by Dario to Simon.

text.jp:
半分に折れた刀身と柄のみの剣
かすかに震えている……
text.official_en:
Half of a broken blade, together with an attached hilt.
It gently pulses in your hand...
text.real_en: A sword broken in half, leaving only part of the blade and its hilt. It trembles faintly...

text.jp:
半分に折れた刀身の剣先部分
かすかに熱を帯びている……
text.official_en:
The front half of a broken blade.
It’s faintly warm to the touch...

text.jp:
反乱軍の兵士ダリオの似顔絵
特徴をよくとらえて描かれている
text.official_en:
A likeness of the rebel soldier Dario.
It captures his characteristics quite well.

text.jp: 地下隧道の閉ざされた扉の鍵
text.official_en: Opens a locked door in the Underground Tunnel.

text.jp:
活力の元になるキノコ
薬の材料として使われる
text.official_en:
A mushroom packed full of energy.
Often used in medicinal compounds.

text.jp: 清浄さが必要な病によく効く薬
text.official_en: Medicine that is particularly effective against illnesses that require purification of the body.

text.jp:
滋養にあふれた肝
ただし見た目は良くない
text.official_en:
A monster’s innards rich in nutrients.
It looks rather unappetizing at a glance.
text.real_en: A nutrient-rich liver, though it doesn’t look very appetizing.

text.jp:
特定の魔力を感知するアンテナ
リドなら使い道がわかりそう
text.official_en:
An antenna attuned to a particular kind of magic.
Lid might have an idea of how to use it.

text.jp:
異界の力を宿した欠片
ビジョンを覚醒させることができる
text.official_en:
A shard imbued with the power of the Farplane.
Has the power to awaken visions.

text.jp:
異界の力を宿した魔石
ビジョンを覚醒させることができる
text.official_en:
A stone imbued with the power of the Farplane.
Has the power to awaken visions.

text.jp:
異界の力を宿した魔石の結晶
ビジョンを覚醒させることができる
text.official_en:
A magicite cryst imbued with the power of the Farplane.
Has the power to awaken visions.
text.real_en:
A magicite crystal imbued with the power of the Farplane.
Has the power to awaken visions.

text.jp:
神秘的な紋様の石片
どこかに集めている人がいそうだが……
text.official_en:
A stone fragment with curious engravings.
No doubt someone out there is collecting these...

text.jp:
精神魔法について記されている
精神世界へ入る魔法を増幅させる
text.official_en: Enhances the magic used to enter the mind of others.
text.real_en: Contains information about mind magic. Amplifies the magic used to enter the mental world.

text.jp:
赤く輝く石
紅玉の洞窟にある石碑に記された場所で拾った
text.official_en:
A gleaming red stone.
Found at the location carved on the stele in Ruby Cave.

text.jp:
非常に硬い稀少な金属
高度な技術があれば武器素材となる
text.official_en:
An extremely hard and rare metal.
Can be used as a material to craft weapons in the right hands.

text.jp: 飛空艇入手後、飛空艇の見た目を魔導船に変えることができる
text.official_en: After acquiring the Enterprise, grants the ability to change its appearance into that of a magitek airship.
text.real_en: After obtaining an airship, you can change its appearance to that of a magitek airship.

text.jp:
高純度のクリスタル
古い魔力に満ちている
text.official_en: A high-purity crystal brimming with ancient magic.

text.jp:
高純度のクリスタル
神聖な魔力に満ちている
text.official_en: A high-purity crystal brimming with divine magic.

text.jp: 魔人と呼ばれる仲間がリミットバースト「ヘルメテオ」を習得する
text.official_en: Grants an ally known as the Archwitch the ability to learn the Fel Meteor limit burst.
text.real_en: Teaches the Limit Burst Hell Meteor to the ally known as the Dark One.

text.jp:
魔力の感知能力を増幅する石
ミシディアレーダーの改造素材になる
text.official_en:
A type of rock that increases magic sensitivity.
Can be used to upgrade the Mysidia Radar.

text.jp:
魔物からまれに取得できる水
様々な病状の進行を抑える効能があるとされている
text.official_en: A rare liquid that can be obtained from a monster. Said to halt the progress of various illnesses.
text.real_en: Water rarely obtained from monsters. Said to slow the progression of various illnesses.
